title: Forest Land Diversion & Illegal Felling
description: Tracks forest clearance approvals, compensatory afforestation compliance, and reported illegal felling, sourced from the Parivesh portal, state forest department records, and independent reporting.

title: Examination Paper Leaks
description: Tracks reported competitive-exam leak incidents, official inquiry outcomes, and re-examination orders.

title: Bureaucratic & Political Corruption
description: Tracks cases with CAG findings, Lokayukta/Lokpal references, or chargesheets filed under the Prevention of Corruption Act.

title: Fake Caste Certification
description: Tracks verified fraudulent caste-certificate cases and related court rulings.

title: Project & Land Allocation Scams
description: Tracks land/project allocation disputes with CAG, court, or tribunal findings.

title: Corporate Concentration & Financial Irregularities
description: Tracks CCI, SEBI, and parliamentary committee findings related to market concentration and financial irregularities. Entries require a regulatory or court source — allegations without an official or on-record journalistic citation are not published.
